A few tiny brown insectlike enemy silhouettes along route. Friendly stylized mechanical 2D game art rendered with premium depth; never realistic tanks or human soldiers. LEFT 40 percent extremely dark near-black negative space fading elegantly into scene, for later typography. Sparse cyan direction seams and gold glints. Exquisite tactile materials, controlled edge light. No dense holograms, no random graphs, no starships, no planets, no neon bloom. Cinematic but readable.
